//ReaderGroups: Groups whose members may read crawl state, as DOMAIN\Group or a bare
group name. Empty or absent means any authenticated user, which is what
this site did before the setting existed. Membership is read from the
Windows token, so a user added to a group must sign in again. A SID such as
S-1-5-32-545 works whether or not IIS supplies a WindowsPrincipal; a name
only works if it does - see live test L4.
